entries.title: Batman: Arkham Asylum
entries.definitive_edition: Game of the Year Edition on Windows

primary.why: Batman: Arkham Asylum released on PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Windows, later received Mac, Return to Arkham console remasters, and a Switch trilogy release. Windows Game of the Year Edition is the best archive route because it has the complete challenge-map package, the highest PC display/capture ceiling, and well-known community fixes.
primary.how_to_play: Use Batman: Arkham Asylum Game of the Year Edition on Windows, applying community compatibility fixes if needed.
